blockingFindings.title: Acceptance fixture no longer exposes dispositionJudgments
blockingFindings.issue: The migrated tests call `acceptanceFixture.dispositionJudgments(...)`, but the added helper implementation in `tests/helpers/acceptance-review-fixture.js` does not define that method or retain `this.deferredFindings`. Those tests will throw before exercising the acceptance-review contract.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Add `this.deferredFindings = Object.freeze(entries)` in `AcceptanceReviewFixture.#writeDeferredEvidence` and restore `AcceptanceReviewFixture.dispositionJudgments(finalDispositions)` so it returns one judgment per deferred finding with `findingId`, `finalDisposition`, and evidence refs.
blockingFindings.rationale: R9 requires all complete target files to pass without weakened assertions. A missing helper method used by multiple touched target tests is a mandatory regression blocker.
